messages:
maria_g: Hey team — getting a 3rd-party escalation: multiple customers report sudden 502s from /v1/generate (streaming) since 10:12 UTC after edge deploy. sample trace id: trace=0ab3f7c2, sample curl: `curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer $$$\" \"https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate\" -d @payload.json` -> returns HTTP/1.1 502 and no body. Only affects streaming requests, not sync completion.

alexander: Noted. Any pattern on API keys / tenant?

maria_g: Looks concentrated on keys tagged `guest-tier` and requests with large prompts (>75k chars) or long-lived streams. Smaller sync requests unaffected.

jamie: I pulled edge metrics — envoy cluster upstream_rq_5xx increased for cluster upstream_generate_guest at 10:12. Envoy logs show upstream reset messages for those trace ids. Snippet: `2026-03-18T10:12:15.123Z envoy info [source/common/http/codec_client.cc:99] upstream reset before response completed`

sre_oncall: Can you paste full envoy log for one trace id? Also check frontdoor/nginx logs for connection errors.

maria_g: Pasting a sanitized log for trace 0ab3f7c2: `envoy: connection id=201234: upstream reset: URX_CONNECTION_RESET while reading response header`

eng_bot: Correlation: lb (frontdoor) shows `recv() failed (104: Connection reset by peer)` for same timestamps.

alexander: Interesting — reset while reading headers suggests upstream (inference runtime) closed connection mid-response. Are these requests using HTTP/1 keep-alive or HTTP/2 multiplexing?

jamie: Most streaming clients negotiate h2 between frontdoor -> edge -> runtime. I repro locally: curl with `-H \"Connection: keep-alive\"` + chunked transfer => fails with 502; same request with `-H \"Connection: close\"` succeeds (200 streaming).

maria_g: That matches customer repros. So keep-alive connection reuse seems tied to the failure.

sre_oncall: Hypothesis: idle/keepalive timeout mismatch + connection reuse leads to corrupted/closed socket when runtime worker reclaims connection for new request. Could be pooled connection handed to new request while previous stream still open due to late ACK.

alexander: Also saw this in trace: `socket closed during stream` followed by `upstream request canceled`. There was a spike in long-lived streaming concurrency right at deploy (model swap). Pool exhaustion + connection reuse race is plausible.

jamie: Quick mitigation options: 1) roll back the edge deploy that changed http connection pooling; 2) set envoy upstream idle_timeout higher or disable connection reuse for guest cluster; 3) route guest-tier streaming to dedicated pool that forces Connection: close.

karen: Which is fastest to ship? We need an immediate customer-facing mitigation.

sre_oncall: Short term: add a temporary route rule to add `Connection: close` for guest-tier streaming paths (edge config change). That avoids reuse and should drop 502s. I'll push a patch to edge routing.

alexander: Also want to capture a repro curl we used: `cat payload.json | curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer GUEST_KEY\" -H \"Transfer-Encoding: chunked\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" --data-binary @- https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate?stream=true` — with keep-alive it fails; with `-H \"Connection: close\"` it works.

maria_g: I'm contacting impacted customers with the workaround: add `Connection: close` header until we patch edge.

jamie: Long term: we should add a connection-lifecycle metric to runtime (conn_reuse_count, conn_stale_close) and add a health check for long-lived streams vs pool eviction. Also add simulated load test with large streaming prompts to catch this in staging.

sre_oncall: Patch rolled to edge routing (feature flag) at 10:32 UTC for guest cluster: temporarily setting `connection_options: close` for /v1/generate?stream=true when tenant=guest-tier. Monitoring now — 502s dropped from ~8% -> <0.5% for affected tenants.

maria_g: Customer update sent, they confirmed improved behavior. I'll keep thread open until we have a root-cause PR.

alexander: Follow-ups: 1) revert keep-alive pooling change in next deploy until we add tighter idle-timeouts; 2) add unit test in envoy config CI to assert streaming + keepalive behavior; 3) postmortem to capture timeline and KPIs.

eng_bot: Oncall created incident INC-2026-0318-02 and assigned to @sre_oncall.

karen: Thanks all — tagging product and runtime for follow-up (will schedule a deep-dive next week).
